description: This file defines a wizard for tracking and splitting stock move lines in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including form definitions, validation, and move line creation logic.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: A wizard interface class for tracking stock move lines, including validation and processing states.

methods.name: _check_picking
methods.description: Validates that the stock move has an associated picking before proceeding.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Splits a stock move into multiple lines with new production lots based on specified quantity and prefix.
